<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=I Miss Them|id=A0131}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
In this lesson, JP and Liliana teach us how to ask what's wrong, how to express homesickness, how to give an advice, and how to approve of an idea. Well, not all possibilities but enough to get us started. The keyword is '''extraño''' – I miss.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0030|A0030: Call back later]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0076|A0076: Jet-lag]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0096|A0096: I am allergic]]}}

<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿Qué te pasa?'''
| What's happening to you?
| '''Extraño a mi familia.'''
| I miss my family.
| '''¡Llámalos!'''
| Call them!
| '''Buena idea.'''
| Good idea.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.

| What's happening to you?
| '''Extraño a mi familia.'''
| I miss my family.
| '''¡Llámalos!'''
| Call them!
| '''Buena idea.'''

}}</includeonly>

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| What's happening to you?
| '''¿Qué te pasa?'''
| Well ({{=}} good) ...
| '''Bueno ...'''
| What?
| '''¿Qué?'''
| I miss my country and ({{=}} '''y''') the food.
| '''Extraño mi país y la comida.'''
| Well ...
| '''Bueno ...'''
| ¡And I miss my family!
| '''¡Y extraño a mi familia!'''
| Call them!
| '''¡Llámalos!'''
| Good idea.
| '''Buena idea.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| What's happening to you?
| '''¿Qué te pasa?'''
| Well ({{=}} good) ...
| '''Bueno ...'''
| What?
| '''¿Qué?'''
| I miss my country and ({{=}} '''y''') the food.
| '''Extraño mi país y la comida.'''
| Well ...
| '''Bueno ...'''
| ¡And I miss my family!
| '''¡Y extraño a mi familia!'''

}}</includeonly>
